subject: Request: Limited-term 'Pilot Protect' Discount Approval — CFO Signoff Needed
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adele Park <adele@cardiolens.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Limited-term 'Pilot Protect' Discount Approval — CFO Signoff Needed

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Quick context: CardioLens (Adele) is asking for a time-boxed pilot discount to accelerate a 3-month clinical pilot for their cardiology product. They are a strategic target in Q4 and have signaled they can convert to a committed Dedicated plan if the pilot shows latency and cost improvements.

What I'm proposing for consideration: 
- 20% one-time pilot discount on hosted inference usage for 3 months
- Minimum consumption floor: $12k total over the 3-month pilot (to protect unit economics)
- PilotProtect add-on (observability & higher retention) bundled at 50% list for the pilot only

Why this is unusual: CardioLens wants the discount to be a written exception in the SOW and included as a DocuSign amendment. They also want a short SLA credit if latency exceeds 200ms during clinical windows — we should limit SLA language to monitoring/credits, no long-term guarantees.

Attachments: PilotProtect-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing table) and consumption-profile.csv (customer forecast).

Request: Can we get a conditional CFO signoff for the above structure? If you approve, I will draft the exception memo and the DocuSign amendment. Deal id D-43821.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson | Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Limited-term 'Pilot Protect' Discount Approval — CFO Signoff Needed

Avery,

Thanks for the summary. A few quick notes before formal signoff: 
- The 20% number is in the ballpark but we need to confirm the projected $/token impact with Finance. Please run the attached consumption-profile against typical sequence lengths and include a flat token-assumption scenario.
- The consumption floor looks acceptable but we'll want a clause that allows us to claw back the discount pro-rata if the floor isn't met.
- No open-ended SLA language. If they need a credit mechanism for specific windows, that should be operationally scoped and capped (e.g., 2% of pilot invoice).

If you can provide the simple financial back-of-envelope (two-line P&L) and add the proposed clause language, I can route to CFO for signature. Marking this REQUIRES CFO signoff.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
On Aug 30, 2026, at 09:24 AM, Avery Johnson wrote:
> Quick context: CardioLens (Adele) is asking for a time-boxed pilot discount to accelerate a 3-month clinical pilot for their cardiology product.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Limited-term 'Pilot Protect' Discount Approval — CFO Signoff Needed

Avery / Marissa,

I reviewed the numbers with FinOps. Summary of decision: 
- Approve a conditional 20% pilot discount for three months subject to:
  * Consumption floor of $12k as proposed
  * Pro-rata clawback if floor not met (clause to be in SOW)
  * Discount limited strictly to hosted inference & PilotProtect bundle during pilot window only
- Cap our SLA credit exposure to a single-point operational credit of up to 2% of the pilot invoice if there is a verifiable latency breach during clinical hours; Ops will own escalation.

Next steps for the sales doc:
- Avery: Draft the exception memo (one pager) that includes the P&L back-of-envelope and the exact clause text for clawback and SLA cap.
- I will prepare an approval note for Marissa (CFO signoff) and attach the Finance clearance memo.

Deal id D-43821. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: finance-clearance-summary.xlsx (summary attached to internal thread)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, CardioLens Legal <legal@cardiolens.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Limited-term 'Pilot Protect' Discount Approval — CFO Signoff Needed

Adele,

Thanks for the quick responses in our call today. We have internal conditional approval to proceed with the following pilot terms (final sign-off to be attached to the DocuSign amendment):

- 20% discount on hosted inference usage for a 3-month PilotProtect pilot
- Minimum consumption floor: $12,000 over the 3-month pilot; pro-rata clawback if not met
- PilotProtect observability add-on at 50% list for the pilot window only
- SLA credit: up to 2% of the pilot invoice if verified latency breaches occur during agreed clinical windows

I will circulate the one-page exception memo and the DocuSign amendment by EOD tomorrow for legal review and signature (DocuSign link will be provided). Once DocuSign is complete, we'll kick off onboarding with the Customer Success pilot checklist.

Thanks — appreciate your flexibility here.

Best,
Avery
